facts.fact: Algeria's national labelling committee, chaired by the ministry's startups director Chamseddine Benmoussat, awards the startup label, with about 15% of over 100,000 applications on start-up.dz obtaining it.

systems.owner: Ministry of Knowledge Economy, Startups and Micro-enterprises
systems.tiers: four labels: innovative project, start-up, incubator, scale-up

DZA.note: Incubator label is mentioned but no hub, programme or park is described.
